scope.cavp: NIST CAVP validations for ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS
scope.esv: NIST CMVP Entropy Source Validation certificates (SP 800-90B)
scope.cc: Common Criteria Portal certified + archived lists, ANSSI (CC and CSPN), ENISA EUCC
excluded: national programmes other than those listed

cavp.label: NIST CAVP — ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS

fips.pqcCoverage/classicalAlgorithms/cmvpAppr: NIST CMVP certificate page — Approved Algorithms
fips.date/lab/cmvpValidationHistory: NIST CMVP certificate page — Validation History
fips.securityTargetUrls: link to the NIST-hosted Security Policy (document link only)

cavp.cavpCapabilities: NIST CAVP product page + its capability endpoint

esv.vendor/productName/date/lab/esvValidatio: NIST ESV certificate page (Validation History); vendor and implementation name also on the ESV list
esv.esvEntropyClaims (with each row's operat: NIST ESV certificate page — entropy table (operating environments, vetted conditioning component CAVP certificates)
esv.additionalDocuments: link to the NIST-hosted Public Use Document (document link only)
esv.status: Validated — NIST publishes no lifecycle status for entropy certificates

esvlinks.entropyCertificates/entropyCertificatesS: the 'Entropy Certificates' table of the module's NIST-hosted Security Policy; read only when that table is present and unambiguous (policy URL, table and PDF page are recorded)

cc.pqcCoverage/classicalAlgorithms/lab: CC Portal-hosted ST/CR PDFs (kept as-is, D-SRC-3)

anssi.status: ANSSI catalogue or CC Portal list
anssi.type: CSPN when the ANSSI reference is CSPN

eucc.pqcCoverage: ENISA-hosted documents (kept as-is, D-SRC-3); empty for newly listed certificates
